T6_declared_line_windows.rule: the window mean of each declared field over the records of the hour before the newest record (by timestamp); a stop when the mean crosses the line from the entry's run-hour (run-hour = the newest record's elapsed_s, carried seconds included, / 3600)

T5_bodies_each_rule_reads.numbering: bodies numbered from 1 (proprio_token.py SKIP and the posture reading); body b is index b - 1 of a stats record's per_body arrays; prediction_audit.EXCLUDED_BODIES = (2,) is 0-based index 2, which is body 3

rules.M4 (all-slot paths, 20-report windows): next_frame_norm.ratio: the live lesson's next-model-step squared error over the whole batch of 8 bodies (lem_model.py: F.mse_loss over the batch tensor) over its running no-change error; bodies 1 and 3 included, each weighted by its absolute error
rules.M6, M9 (all-slot paths, every full repor: heads_all_slot_path.heads.<head>.output_rms and fixed.<head>: the path's output over the newest lesson rows of all bodies (up to 64 = 8 lesson calls x 8 bodies), pooled
rules.M7, M8 (all-slot paths, 1,000-model-step: prediction_audit_hold_first per_body cells without index 2 (body 3): bodies 1, 2 and 4-8 pooled by their summed errors
rules.declared prediction entries (5-minute ch: prediction_audit_per_body ... without_body_2.ratio: bodies 1, 2 and 4-8 pooled; body 3 in none (the correction, item 2: not a protection of body 3, not a per-body guarantee for body 1)
rules.M3 (all-slot paths): the paths' hidden-layer live share: whole model, no body

T5_bodies_each_rule_reads.no_per_body_stop_line: no stop line reads body 1 or body 3 alone; their prediction is reported per body in the outcome receipt's retained findings and in the hourly reading (completion/body_prediction.py)
